title: Fire Restoration Leads | Fire Damage, Smoke, & More

facts.fact: Partners can pause their entire service area or individual counties for a duration of 3 hours up to 7 days.
facts.quote: You can choose to pause your entire service area or individual counties for a duration of 3 hours up to 7 days.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, most of its partners receive their first fire restoration lead within two weeks of activating their account.
facts.quote: most of our partners receive their first smoke or fire restoration lead within two weeks of activating their account.

facts.fact: According to the vendor's own call statistics, roughly 7 out of every 10 calls turn into viable jobs.
facts.quote: Based on our call statistics, roughly 7 out of every 10 calls turn into viable jobs.

facts.fact: The vendor states it does not charge monthly service fees or require a long-term contract, and partners are billed only for valid fire and smoke restoration leads.
facts.quote: We do not charge fees or require a long-term contract and you are only billed for valid fire and smoke restoration leads.

facts.fact: The vendor automatically bills the partner's credit card each week for valid leads.
facts.quote: We will automatically bill your credit card each week for your valid smoke and fire restoration leads.

facts.fact: When a partner first signs up, the vendor places a small hold on the partner's credit card, which is released once the account is verified.
facts.quote: When you first sign up, we do place a small hold on your credit card to verify your account is in good standing.

facts.fact: The initial partner setup includes a 15-minute call to secure the service area and a 30-minute training call before account activation.
facts.quote: A 15 minute call to secure your service area, confirm the services you offer, and verify your restoration business qualifications.

facts.fact: A third-party partner testimonial (Alex Duta, Romexterra Construction) reports spending roughly $30,000 in one year and receiving over $400,000 in business from that investment.
facts.quote: I spent roughly around $30,000 last year and got over $400,000 worth of business from that investment.

facts.fact: The vendor sends each fire and smoke damage lead exclusively to one partner rather than to several restoration companies.
facts.quote: we send each lead to only one partner.
